content.title: How to watch Braves vs. Phillies: TV channel and streaming options for April 18
content.text: Matt Olson rides a 10-game hitting streak into the Atlanta Braves’ game versus the Philadelphia Phillies, at 7:15 p.m. ET on Saturday, at Citizens Bank Park. Cristopher Sanchez (2-1, 2.01 ERA) gets the start for the Phillies, who are 8-11 this season and fourth in the NL East. Chris Sale (3-1, 3.27 ERA) is starting for the Braves, who are 13-7 and first in the NL East.How to watch Atlanta Braves vs. Philadelphia Phillies Venue: Citizens Bank Park Time: 7:15 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: FOX Watching in person? He has hit five long balls (18th in MLB) and driven in 15 runs with a strikeout rate of 27% and a walk rate of 13.5%. and has scored 16 runs (11th in MLB).
